    Object quotients of scalar mesh categories #

    graded-category.tex (eq:mesh-object-quotient) and Subsection 5.2 (mesh-deformations.tex).

    • The retraction kQ → kQ_S maps the mesh ideal of Q into that of Q_S (restrict_mem_meshIdealSub): a mesh relation based in S restricts to the mesh relation of Q_S, and one based outside S consists of paths through vertices outside S, which the retraction kills.
    • In the object quotient C/[D], a morphism of kQ vanishes exactly when it lies in the mesh ideal plus the paths through D (objectQuotient_map_eq_zero_iff).
